headline: Nigerian Naira Slides to N1,440/$ as Foreign Exchange Reserves Fall $406 Million
summary: The Nigerian naira depreciated to N1,440 per dollar in parallel market trading as country foreign exchange reserves dropped by $406 million over the past month.
why: Naira liquidity and reserve levels govern foreign exchange access for West Africa's largest market, affecting import costs and sovereign debt obligations.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Decreased foreign exchange reserve buffers constrained dollar availability, weakening local currency rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A $406 million monthly drop in central bank foreign reserves restricted dollar liquidity, pushing parallel exchange rates down.
